claims.text: US President Donald Trump announced on Friday that US special envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner are traveling to Kyiv and Moscow to present a proposal aimed at ending the war.
Russian state news agency TASS reported that US envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner will visit Moscow on Saturday and Sunday.
Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy stated that Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner will visit Ukraine on Sunday, marking their first trip there since Donald Trump returned to power.
A Russian drone strike hit the headquarters of Ukraine's SBU security services in Kyiv on Friday, injuring at least 12 people according to Mayor Vitali Klitschko.
US President Donald Trump attributed the ongoing conflict to a personality problem between Volodymyr Zelenskyy and Vladimir Putin, stating that both leaders truly hate each other.
A July study by the Center for Strategic and International Studies estimates the war has cost Russia around 450,000 lives and Ukraine between 125,000 and 150,000 fatalities.
Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy proposed a temporary ceasefire with Russia during the upcoming visits of US envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner.
Volodymyr Zelenskyy accused Moscow of directly targeting the personal office of the SBU chief during the daytime drone attack on the agency's headquarters.
Ukrainian Foreign Minister Andriy Sybiga described the drone strike on the SBU central building on Volodymyrska Street in Kyiv as a major escalation.
The acting head of the SBU, Oleksandr Poklad, was not inside the building during the drone attack and was unharmed.
The Friday drone strike was the first time the SBU headquarters had been hit since the start of Russia's invasion in 2022.
Volodymyr Zelenskyy proposed that Ukraine would conduct no airstrikes if Russia reciprocates with a ceasefire for the duration of the peace talks.
Russian President Vladimir Putin stated at an international economic forum on Thursday that there are chances for a peace deal, while maintaining demands for territorial concessions from Ukraine.
Russia currently controls approximately 20% of Ukrainian territory following its full-scale invasion launched in February 2022.
Volodymyr Zelenskyy confirmed Ukraine agreed to keep Russian airspace operating normally to ensure US envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner can travel safely.
An overnight Russian assault on the Odesa region killed one person and left at least five others injured, including a child.
Overnight Russian strikes in the Dnipro region killed two police officials.
The UN General Assembly voted 164 to 1, with six abstentions, to adopt the Correct the Map resolution replacing traditional world maps with one accurately representing Africa's size.
The United States was the only country to vote against the UN General Assembly resolution to adopt a new world map projection.
The Mercator map shows Africa as similar in size to Greenland, whereas Africa is actually 14 times larger than Greenland.
The African Union's 54 member states formally adopted the Equal Earth projection map in February.
French Foreign Minister Jean-Noël Barrot announced that his ministry will cease using the Mercator map.
US representative Yaryna Ferencevych criticized the UN resolution, stating it mocked the General Assembly's purpose by debating 16th-century map projects instead of genuine international peace.
The Correct the Map resolution adopted by the UN General Assembly was sponsored by African Union member states and the Bahamas.
The UN resolution is non-legally binding and does not challenge the use of the Mercator projection for maritime and aerial navigation.
Togolese Foreign Minister Robert Dussey stated that Togo hopes to transition its school geography materials away from the Mercator map by the end of the year.
A team of cartographers created the Equal Earth cartographic projection map in 2018.

French Foreign Minister Jean-Noël Barrot stated at Sorbonne University that on the Mercator map, the United States, Russia, and China take on disproportionate visual prominence compared to Africa, Latin America, or Southeast Asia.
France announced it will switch to using the Eckert IV map projection following the UN resolution.
Togo plans to host an implementation event in Lomé with UNESCO, the African Union, and technology companies including Google Maps during the first quarter of next year.
German historian Arno Peters launched the Peters world map based on the Gall-Peters projection in 1973 as an alternative to the Mercator projection.
Reform UK leader Nigel Farage was heckled by protesters while addressing the party's annual conference in Birmingham on Friday.
Two senior advisers to Nigel Farage, James Orr and Dan Jukes, stepped down following an undercover investigation alleging Reform UK arranged foreign-funded political polling.
The governing Labour Party wrote to the Metropolitan Police requesting an investigation into potential criminal political funding offences by Reform UK.
An undercover investigation by group Verbatim broadcast on Channel 4 alleged Reform UK arranged for a US company to pay over £30,000 for three opinion polls.
James Orr stated that the polling was paid for by an independent person and published immediately to the public, denying it constituted a benefit to Reform UK.
Nigel Farage is under parliamentary investigation over a £5 million donation received from crypto-billionaire Christopher Harborne in 2024.
The Electoral Commission stated it has not approved the donor vetting process for Reform UK or any other political party.
James Orr is an associate professor of divinity at the University of Cambridge and has served as Reform UK's head of policy since February.
The University of Cambridge announced it is looking into the conduct of associate professor James Orr following allegations raised in the broadcast.
Undercover footage captured Nigel Farage meeting fake US donors over lunch in Clacton and saying thank you both and all above board regarding a proposed donation through a UK intermediary.
Nigel Farage described the undercover investigation as an exercise in entrapment and referred to the claims as loose pub talk.
The Liberal Democrats requested the UK parliamentary standards commissioner to investigate Nigel Farage's conduct.
US Vice President JD Vance has previously referred to James Orr as his intellectual mentor and British Sherpa.
In undercover footage, James Orr was recorded saying of the poll funding arrangement that Nigel Farage doesn't know, won't know.
Houthi forces launched a ground offensive on Thursday against Saudi Arabia-led coalition forces supporting Yemen's government-in-exile.
An AFP tally indicated that 129 people have died as of Friday in renewed fighting between Houthis and government forces in western Yemen.
Heavy shelling and artillery fire forced hundreds of families to flee from the coastal cities of Hodeidah and Mokha.
The Houthis are seeking to gain control of ports and elevated terrain near the Bab el-Mandeb Strait connecting the Red Sea to the Gulf of Aden.
Yemeni government forces recaptured the al-Khazan and al-Makahna hills in the Jabal Habashi district west of Taiz city.
A ballistic missile attack on a restaurant in the coastal city of al-Makha killed several civilians and injured others, according to state TV.
A Houthi source stated that more than 100 fighters from both sides have been killed since the offensive began on Thursday.
The Houthis previously controlled the port city of al-Makha before being driven out in 2017 by government forces and the Saudi-led coalition.
US average diesel prices reached a record high of $5.85 per gallon on Friday.
US diesel prices have increased by about 55% since the US-Israeli conflict with Iran began on February 28, when the national average was $3.76 a gallon.
Brent crude oil was trading above $95 a barrel on Friday, up from around $70 before the conflict with Iran.
US East Coast distillate inventories fell to a record low of 19.3 million barrels in the week ended August 28.
Russia restricted diesel exports through September 30 following Ukrainian drone attacks on Russian oil refineries.
The average price of regular gasoline in the US reached $4.15 per gallon, up from $2.98 prior to the war with Iran.
According to AAA, the $5.85 per gallon US diesel price surpassed the previous record of $5.81 set in June 2022.
Approximately 90% of US school buses operate on diesel fuel.
US President Donald Trump announced an oil agreement with Venezuela intended to lower US fuel prices.
In January, former Venezuelan leader Nicolás Maduro was seized by US special forces during a raid authorized by President Donald Trump.
Venezuelan Interim President Delcy Rodríguez stated that the oil deal involves developing 17 strategic oil fields with 65 billion barrels of potential and over $100 billion in investment.
A Reuters/Ipsos poll showed President Donald Trump's approval rating dropped to 33%, with only 31% of Americans approving of the Iran war.
